interface.longDescription: A ChatGPT plugin for moving chat and project work to new conversations or other AI tools, preserving context, decisions, files, and next steps. Review side-chat proposals before adopting them. Supports lightweight handoff/.push, full-package transfer/.export, pickup, fold, handoffs, and export project. Uses available host file and context capabilities; does not automatically copy native chat histories, access unseen projects, or send data to another AI service.

name: chat-handoff
